name: Periodic notes
description: A month calendar in the sidebar: each day with dots for its daily note's length and its open tasks, a click opening or making it. Daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly notes, each with its folder, name format and template, and commands to open them.
author: Vaultite
forAgents: A daily, weekly or monthly note (today's, last week's): `periodic_notes_note` (`vau calendar note today`, `week --offset -1`) gives its path, made from its template.

confirmCreate.label: Confirm before creating
confirmCreate.description: ask before a click on the calendar makes a note that isn't there yet

weekStart.label: Start week on
weekStart.description: the calendar's first day of the week, and how gggg and ww number weeks (from Monday: as ISO's)

weekNumbers.label: Show week numbers
weekNumbers.description: a column of week numbers, a click opening the weekly note

wordsPerDot.label: Words per dot
wordsPerDot.description: how many words of a daily note each of its dots stands for, up to five

dailyFolder.label: Daily notes folder
dailyFolder.description: where daily notes go; unset, as Obsidian says, else where daily notes are (Daily)

dailyFormat.label: Daily note name
dailyFormat.description: its file name, a moment.js format (YYYY-MM-DD); a / makes folders

dailyTemplate.label: Daily note template
dailyTemplate.description: the template a new daily note starts from, by path or by name in the templates folder; {{date}}, {{title}} filled in

weekly.label: Weekly notes
weekly.description: a note for each week; unset, as Obsidian's Periodic Notes says (else off)

weeklyFormat.label: Weekly note name
weeklyFormat.description: its file name, a moment.js format (gggg-[W]ww; GGGG-[W]WW for ISO weeks); a / makes folders

weeklyTemplate.label: Weekly note template
weeklyTemplate.description: the template a new weekly note starts from, by path or by name in the templates folder; {{date}}, {{title}} filled in
